file_roles.evidence: Every 'throw new FrontendException("Unsupported query...")' in the extractor is replaced by LOG.warn plus canPushDown = false, and getPColCondition/isFilterRemovable honour the flag; this is the behaviour the issue asks to change.
transform() now runs the extractor on filterExpr.deepCopy() and restores it with loFilter.setFilterPlan(filterExprCopy) when not pushable, so a failed push-down cannot leave the plan half modified.

rationale: The issue is a policy change (do not throw when filters cannot be pushed up). The throwing code is in the extractor; the optimizer change protects the plan from partial edits that the new non-throwing path would allow.
notes: Not a crash bug, so what counts as the defect is partly a matter of reading the issue as a bug.
